2em] uppercase text-cream/40">AnticipyPendant firmware update

Connect Pendant

This page uses the Web Bluetooth API (navigator.bluetooth) and the web-bluetooth-dfu library to flash firmware to your Anticipy pendant. Audio never leaves your device. Pairing happens in your browser; only a stub log row is sent to the local Mac engine.
